CSP9.1 preparation uses starport-managed-material, branch codex/starport-managed-material, at 47a9cb3. Its two warm-path regressions fail as expected. Three warm requests cause three additional repository reads in each credential role. The baseline proof records a 15.2 ms account lookup with about 64 MiB allocated per operation.

Use GOWORK=/tmp/csp91-host-integration.work for this local pair. Preserve the reviewed CSP9 worktrees. Implement scoped material caching, bounded freshness, mutation invalidation, and stale-load fencing together. Shared grants remain independent of cached secrets. No processes remain active.
